notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Changeling Berserker.
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
When Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, it and Pandemonium trigger.
Resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger, exiling Bladewing until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing damage to Changeling Berserker equal to Changeling Berserker's power.
Changeling Berserker dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
When Changeling Berserker dies, it triggers, returning Bladewing from exile to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Pandemonium trigger.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing damage equal to Bladewing's power to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning Changeling Berserker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
